ModMetaData.name: World Feature Text Compatibility 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Local
ModMetaData.description: Windows / RimWorld 1.7.4976. Fixes Korean world feature names entering the broken legacy TextMesh path. Prepares the syllables used by world names with the installed Malgun Gothic font and uses the native TextMeshPro renderer. Keeps world names, positions, wrapping, visibility and language. No font files or game assemblies are bundled. Requires C:\Windows\Fonts\malgun.ttf. Readable Fonts 1.7 is optional.
